entry.title: New: secret-guard
entry.summary: Blocks agents from reading or writing sensitive files (.env, credentials, key material), masks leaked secret-shaped values in tool results, keeps an audit journal, and exposes safe sg_* inspection tools that never print raw values. Exact install spec: github:johnxu22786/secret-guard. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
